faq.a: Titanium Center embarked on its educational journey in 2017, aspiring to continue its progress with you in the years to come. The center offers several training courses in the field of information technology, in collaboration with instructors holding specialized certifications in their respective fields, both from within and outside Iraq.

faq.q: What courses does Titanium Center offer?
faq.a:
Titanium Center offers a wide range of training programs in the field of information technology, divided into two main tracks to suit all levels:

1) FUTURE WAVE Courses – For Beginners
A program launched by Titanium Center, designed for anyone who wants to enter the field of IT from scratch.

2) Titanium Advanced Courses – Professional Development
Aimed at individuals with limited experience or those working in the field who wish to professionally enhance their skills, these courses include:

• Networking
• Cyber Security
• Databases
• Programming
• System Administration.

faq.q: Is Titanium Center accredited by international organizations?
faq.a:
Yes, Titanium Center is a training center accredited by several leading international IT organizations, including:

• EC-Council
• PECB
• CompTIA

The center also received the Best Emerging Center in the Middle East award from EC-Council, recognizing its excellence in training quality and technical skills development according to the highest international standards.

faq.q: What are the advantages of training at Titanium Center?
faq.a: Training is available both in person and online, maintaining the same high-quality experience. Practical and hands-on courses help in acquiring real-world skills. Internationally accredited certificates are awarded upon completion of the courses. Support and follow-up are provided to trainees during and after the course.
